name: The English Book Depot
description: An iconic bookstore with a cozy café tucked in the back. Smells of fresh paper and dark roast coffee. Ideal for losing an afternoon in a novel.
recommendation: Try the Hibiscus Iced Tea and sit by the window shelf.

name: Chai Under the Pines
description: A quiet wooden stall serving steaming hot ginger chai in clay cups. Surrounded by towering pines and cool mountain breezes.
recommendation: Ginger Cardamom Chai + Bun Makhan toasted over hot coals.

name: Canal Road Trail
description: A leafy path running alongside old irrigation canals. Beautifully quiet during light showers with views of distant green ridges.
recommendation: Go around 5 PM just as the streetlights begin to flicker on.

name: Ellora's Melting Moments
description: An old-school bakery from the Ruskin Bond era. Cozy, nostalgic, and filled with the scent of vanilla essence and butter cream.
recommendation: Famous Butter Toffees (Stick Jaws) and Plum Cake.

name: FRI Grounds
description: Colossal Roman-style brick campus surrounded by dense botanical gardens. A massive quiet space to sketch, walk, or just sit under ancient trees.
recommendation: Carry a notebook and walk down the main tree-lined boulevard.

name: Daia's Cafe & Bakery
description: Tucked away in a quiet neighbourhood lane. A warm bakery-café with fresh slices of cake, a cup of coffee, and a very relaxed, intimate setting away from the loud crowds.
recommendation: Their fresh pastries in the morning are heavenly. Bring a book.

name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters
description: A brilliant atmosphere for settling down with a notebook. Freshly roasted coffee, ambient music, and comfortable seating. Great for writing, reading, or a quiet conversation.
recommendation: Order their seasonal cold brew and grab a window seat.

name: The Silent Bakery by the Deaf
description: A truly special and peaceful place. Run by differently-abled staff, it offers a warm, incredibly quiet environment. Known for the absolute freshest croissants, breads, and pastries.
recommendation: Their croissants are legendary. Go early before they sell out.

name: Crossword Bookstore
description: A modern, well-stocked space with a cozy browsing experience. Flip through a few potential reads and enjoy the quiet hum of a dedicated book space.
recommendation: Browse the Indian fiction section — you'll find gems.

name: MDDA Park
description: One of the best spots for lush green surroundings and stunning views of the surrounding hills. Clean, well-maintained, with plenty of quiet benches to sit, relax, and breathe.
recommendation: Perfect for a late afternoon walk when the light gets golden.

name: Deer Park Malsi
description: Despite the name, it is a sprawling, heavily wooded park. Paved walkways, rich green canopy covers, and a calm vibe — perfect for a long, leisurely walk under the trees.
recommendation: Go on a weekday morning for the quietest experience.

name: Synergy Hospital Pharmacy
description: A well-stocked 24/7 medical store and reliable clinic. Keep this address saved in your phone notes. Good to know it's always open.
